nuggets.text: The Owls' press box overlooks the Atlantic, and FAU says no other US football stadium has a view of the open ocean.
Howard Schnellenberger built the Owls' program from scratch and went 6-0 in bowl games, the most of any coach without a loss.
The Owls earned a bowl invitation in 2007, just their seventh year, the second-youngest program ever to get one.
Owls coach Zach Kittley walked on to Abilene Christian's basketball team before choosing to coach football instead.
Zach Kittley's father, Wes, has coached track and field at Texas Tech since 2000.
At Western Kentucky, Zach Kittley's offense jumped from 115th in FBS scoring to 2nd in a single season.
Zach Kittley coached Bailey Zappe at Western Kentucky, where Zappe set FBS single-season records for passing TDs and yards.
The Owls are the only FBS team to bring back their entire coaching staff and starting quarterback, Caden Veltkamp.
Kelby Valsin caught 10 passes for 92 yards and a touchdown in the Owls' opener at Florida.
The Owls' 15-year, $22.5 million stadium naming deal is the largest naming rights deal in the American Conference.
